card.name: Words leading into cause or association
card.fires_on: Small words and word parts that come right before a stated cause, such as 'associated with', 'other contributory factors' and 'no other obvious etiology'. Seen in warnings about causes of an adverse event.

modes.label: Associated with
modes.description: The word 'with' after 'associated' when linking an injury to a drug.

modes.description: Linking words before a list of possible causes.
modes.example: There are many causes of pericarditis,<< including>> infections, injury, radiation treatment, and

card.writes: It seems to push the next word toward cause or factor nouns and away from words like complaints.
card.plain: It fires on little words that lead into a cause, like 'associated with' or 'no other cause'.
